India has one of the largest working population in the world and in the next few decades most of this population will retire. But a majority of this population is not prepared for the retired life.
NPS can be one of the ways for looking at a Retired Life and given the NPS is one of the few ways to Save Taxes in the New Regime, it is worthwhile to understand the product.
